findings: Nyeri sub-county list contains ward-level names — "Kieni East" and "Kieni West" are electoral wards, not administrative sub-counties. Nyeri has 6 official sub-counties: Tetu, Kieni, Mathira, Nyeri Town, Othaya, Mukurweini. Remove the two ward entries from KENYA_SUB_COUNTIES["Nyeri"].

Kirinyaga sub-county list contains a non-existent entry — "Kirinyaga East" is not an official sub-county. The 4 official sub-counties are Mwea, Gichugu, Ndia, and Kirinyaga Central. Remove "Kirinyaga East" from KENYA_SUB_COUNTIES["Kirinyaga"].

Chepalungu in Kericho sub-county list — Chepalungu sub-county is administered under Bomet County; it appears in Kericho's KENYA_SUB_COUNTIES list in addition to Bomet's. Verify against the current KNBS/IEBC administrative boundary list and remove the incorrect entry from whichever county it doesn't belong to.

Round-robin assignment produces misleading per-facility sub-county data — there is no runtime warning in the output CSV or in the clinic locator UI. Consider adding a visible disclaimer in the UI so users don't trust individual facility sub-county labels.

Laikipia will always show only Laikipia West in the clinic locator — only 1 OSM facility exists for Laikipia, so the round-robin never cycles to Laikipia East or Laikipia North. Source-data gap; no pipeline fix available without richer source data.

932 facilities default-classified as Public — any blank or unrecognised OSM operator tag becomes Public. A mapping of common OSM operator strings or a cross-reference against KMHFL ownership fields would reduce noise.
